facebook.caption: POV: you wander off Nguyễn Văn Trỗi and find Quán Ăn 93 tucked into Khu 2. No tourist signs. No English menu out front. Just 350 locals who rated it 4.3 stars and kept coming back. Solid bistro meal for $15-30 a head. In Phu Quoc, that hits different. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
